## What it is

A short rib, one integrated hook, and a slot gauge, joined by a link. The digit is 1. Print this before the four towers.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down, like a tower. The gauge is two cheeks and a back wall. The gap is 6.2 mm wide and the cheeks are 3.4 mm tall, open on top.
- Snap the link off and set the tab into the gauge. The 0.2 mm allowance is a design choice. If it binds, raise `joint_clear` before printing the towers.
- The hook on the coupon is the same neck, fillet, bore, and mouth as the towers.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the coil is the right length. It only checks the slot and one hook.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: hook is part of the rib, with the 3 mm root fillet. The gauge is unchanged.
